title: E91 and Entanglement-Based QKD
description: Ekert's protocol, Bell's theorem and the CHSH inequality for security

questions.question: The E91 protocol was introduced in 1991 by
options: Artur Ekert
researchers
Charles Bennett
Peter Shor
questions.correctAnswer: Artur Ekert

questions.question: In E91, the entangled photon pairs are produced by
options: Alice, who prepares them and sends them to Bob over a quantum link
a source that sends one photon of each pair to Alice and the other to Bob
were measured in any basis, with mismatched ones later corrected by Alice
a satellite that stores the pairs until both parties are ready
questions.correctAnswer: a source that sends one photon of each pair to Alice and the other to Bob

questions.question: The entangled pairs used in E91 are the physical realisation of
options: $|+\rangle = (|0\rangle + |1\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$ and $|-\rangle = (|0\rangle - |1\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$
probability amplitudes along alternative paths add before squaring, so they can reinforce or cancel
Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen pairs, whose members have correlated but individually undefined properties
long-lived quantum memories and high-fidelity entanglement purification at many intermediate nodes
questions.correctAnswer: Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen pairs, whose members have correlated but individually undefined properties

questions.question: Bell's theorem shows that
options: no theory of local hidden variables can reproduce all the predictions of quantum mechanics
a measurement on one wing cannot instantaneously influence the outcome at the distant wing
local hidden variable theories agree with quantum mechanics only for entangled states
the attenuation of light in the fibre, which reduces the photon arrival rate with distance
questions.correctAnswer: no theory of local hidden variables can reproduce all the predictions of quantum mechanics

questions.question: The CHSH inequality is a testable statement of the form
options: $|S| \ge 2$ for any local hidden variable theory
$|S| \le 1$ for any local hidden variable theory
$|S| \le 4$ for any local hidden variable theory
$|S| \le 2$ for any local hidden variable theory
questions.correctAnswer: $|S| \le 2$ for any local hidden variable theory

questions.question: For maximally entangled states, the CHSH parameter can reach
options: Three, corresponding to the three Pauli operators $X$, $Y$ and $Z$
To contrast past and present and show how the narrator has changed
$2\sqrt{2} \approx 2.83$, which exceeds the classical bound of $2$
only entangled states can be copied, while separable states cannot
questions.correctAnswer: $2\sqrt{2} \approx 2.83$, which exceeds the classical bound of $2$

questions.question: In E91, Alice and Bob each measure using
options: E91 uses entangled pairs shared by the two parties, while BB84 uses a single prepare-and-measure channel
a random choice from three bases, two of which supply the key and one of which is used for the Bell test
deploying hybrid classical and post-quantum key exchange, so security holds if either scheme is unbroken
photons cannot be amplified without adding noise, so losses must be compensated by entanglement swapping
questions.correctAnswer: a random choice from three bases, two of which supply the key and one of which is used for the Bell test

questions.question: In E91, an eavesdropper is detected because she
options: produces one definite outcome, and the state after the measurement is the corresponding basis state
must interact with the entangled photons, which breaks the correlations tested by Bell's inequality
follows from the laws of physics rather than from the current difficulty of a computational problem
probability amplitudes along alternative paths add before squaring, so they can reinforce or cancel
questions.correctAnswer: must interact with the entangled photons, which breaks the correlations tested by Bell's inequality

questions.question: Why does a violation of the CHSH inequality signal eavesdropping in E91?
options: A qubit can be a coherent superposition of $|0\rangle$ and $|1\rangle$, whereas a classical bit is always exactly $0$ or exactly $1$
QKD security is based on physical principles rather than computational hardness, and can be proven secure even against unbounded computation
every plaintext of that length is consistent with the same ciphertext, so the ciphertext carries no information about the plaintext
with ideal devices the observed correlations are the entangled ones, so a departure from them can only come from outside interference
questions.correctAnswer: with ideal devices the observed correlations are the entangled ones, so a departure from them can only come from outside interference

questions.question: Which measurements in E91 provide the shared key?
options: the information an eavesdropper can obtain is bounded by a computable quantity no matter how much computing power is used
any attempt to gain information about a quantum state disturbs it, and the disturbance appears as errors in the shared key
the basis announcements alone reveal no information about the sifted bits, and Eve's disturbances are caught by testing the key
those in the two bases not reserved for the Bell test, keeping the settings that satisfy the required correlation condition
questions.correctAnswer: those in the two bases not reserved for the Bell test, keeping the settings that satisfy the required correlation condition

questions.question: The essential difference between E91 and BB84 is that
options: deploying hybrid classical and post-quantum key exchange, so security holds if either scheme is unbroken
a random choice from three bases, two of which supply the key and one of which is used for the Bell test
E91 uses entangled pairs shared by the two parties, while BB84 uses a single prepare-and-measure channel
photons cannot be amplified without adding noise, so losses must be compensated by entanglement swapping
questions.correctAnswer: E91 uses entangled pairs shared by the two parties, while BB84 uses a single prepare-and-measure channel

questions.question: E91 is a candidate for device-independent QKD because
options: it has produced standardised algorithms for the post-quantum era, encouraging migration before quantum computers arrive
its security can be established from observed correlations alone, without trusting the internal operation of the devices
the information an eavesdropper can obtain is bounded by a computable quantity no matter how much computing power is used
two non-orthogonal bases are needed, so that no measurement can identify the basis without introducing detectable errors
questions.correctAnswer: its security can be established from observed correlations alone, without trusting the internal operation of the devices

questions.question: The main experimental obstacle to device-independent QKD is
options: Quantum gates are deterministic only when the input state is an eigenstate of the gate
a source of key material that must be combined with authenticated classical encryption
single repeater to create a long-distance pair in one step, with no intermediate nodes
the very high detection efficiency and low loss needed to close the detection loophole
questions.correctAnswer: the very high detection efficiency and low loss needed to close the detection loophole

questions.question: A Bell test used to certify security must be designed to
options: hashes the remaining bits so that Eve's information about them is reduced to a negligible amount
$|+\rangle = (|0\rangle + |1\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$ and $|-\rangle = (|0\rangle - |1\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$
close the locality and detection loopholes, otherwise the violation can be explained classically
factors large integers and computes discrete logarithms in polynomial time on a quantum computer
questions.correctAnswer: close the locality and detection loopholes, otherwise the violation can be explained classically

questions.question: In E91, Alice and Bob can check that their photons really were entangled by
options: $|0\rangle \to (|0\rangle + |1\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$ and $|1\rangle \to (|0\rangle - |1\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$
testing whether the observed correlations violate a Bell inequality for more than one pair of settings
chain of repeaters that each share entanglement with their neighbours to extend entanglement end to end
certified randomness, in which the observed Bell violation guarantees that the bits are unpredictable
questions.correctAnswer: testing whether the observed correlations violate a Bell inequality for more than one pair of settings

questions.question: For an entangled pair, each photon's individual polarisation is
options: the practical difficulty of factoring a large product of two large primes
completely random, while the pair's joint results are strongly correlated
fixed at the moment of creation and merely unknown to the observers
convert a plaintext into a ciphertext that cannot be read without the key
questions.correctAnswer: completely random, while the pair's joint results are strongly correlated

questions.question: Bell's theorem relies on the locality assumption that
options: the attenuation of light in the fibre, which reduces the photon arrival rate with distance
no theory of local hidden variables can reproduce all the predictions of quantum mechanics
demonstrating satellite-to-ground quantum key distribution over intercontinental distances
a measurement on one wing cannot instantaneously influence the outcome at the distant wing
questions.correctAnswer: a measurement on one wing cannot instantaneously influence the outcome at the distant wing

questions.question: A further assumption in Bell tests is that the measurement settings are chosen
options: factoring is already in polynomial time classically, so quantum computers add nothing
randomly and independently of the source, which closes the freedom-of-choice loophole
one real parameter, since only $|0\rangle$ and $|1\rangle$ can occur in an experiment
a quantum state can always be copied provided enough energy and cooling are available
questions.correctAnswer: randomly and independently of the source, which closes the freedom-of-choice loophole

questions.question: In an E91 run, the parties abort when the measured
options: polarisation drift exceeds the birefringence limit of the fibre
The committee made the decision to postpone the vote until next week.
photon count falls below the bandwidth of the classical channel
CHSH parameter falls below the value required to certify a secure key
questions.correctAnswer: CHSH parameter falls below the value required to certify a secure key

questions.question: A further application of entangled-pair experiments is
options: A qubit is always in one definite state, but that state is chosen by hardware rather than by the user
A state in which the system is classically in two states at once, each with its own definite property
an implementation can deviate from the ideal model and open side channels an eavesdropper can exploit
certified randomness, in which the observed Bell violation guarantees that the bits are unpredictable
questions.correctAnswer: certified randomness, in which the observed Bell violation guarantees that the bits are unpredictable

questions.question: The DiVincenzo criteria list the conditions a physical device must satisfy to run a quantum cryptography protocol, including
options: chain of repeaters that each share entanglement with their neighbours to extend entanglement end to end
photons cannot be amplified without adding noise, so losses must be compensated by entanglement swapping
larger moduli make factoring harder, which is why recommended RSA key sizes have grown over the decades
the ability to initialise, manipulate and read out qubits, together with isolation from the environment
questions.correctAnswer: the ability to initialise, manipulate and read out qubits, together with isolation from the environment

questions.question: Compared with BB84, the security analysis of E91 is
options: based on directly counting the number of photons an eavesdropper removed
computational, resting on the difficulty of a problem such as integer factoring
expressed directly in terms of observed Bell violations and entropic quantities
expressed in terms of the size of the RSA modulus used for authentication
questions.correctAnswer: expressed directly in terms of observed Bell violations and entropic quantities
